description: You are a senior Interior Designer at Atelier Loft Studios, commissioned to convert a residential apartment into a modern open-plan coworking office for a tech startup with 12 employees. The apartment shell is open in Sweet Home 3D with all residential furniture removed. Transform this space into a professional work environment with an executive area, a collaborative open workspace, a client reception, and a staff lounge with kitchenette. Define room boundaries for each zone so the floor plan is self-documenting. Apply distinct floor colors or textures to visually differentiate each functional area. Install doors where privacy or noise separation is needed between zones. Furnish the entire space to professional office standards with appropriate seating, work surfaces, storage, lighting, and decorative elements. Use only Sweet Home 3D's built-in catalog. Save the file when complete.
